Standards require switchback, geo, or market-level designs.","evidence_quote":"A/B test randomized by driver.","citations":["experimentation-standards#marketplace-interference"],"recommendation":"Use a switchback, geo, or zone/market-level randomization and account for neighboring-zone interference."},{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"Test duration under 14 days","detail":"A 5-day run does not cover two full weekly cycles, and there is no Data Science sign-off for a shorter test. This also conflicts with the proposal's 6-week target window.","evidence_quote":"Run for 5 days.","citations":["experimentation-standards#duration-and-seasonality"],"recommendation":"Run for at least 14 days, or obtain and record Data Science sign-off for a shorter test."},{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"No MDE, power, or stopping rule pre-registered","detail":"The plan does not state a minimum detectable effect, sample size or power, or a stopping rule, all of which pre-registration requires.","evidence_quote":"","citations":["experimentation-standards#pre-registration"],"recommendation":"Pre-register the primary metric, MDE, sample size or power, and stopping rule before launch."}]}
